text.p: These are the leading stories in Zambia's newspapers on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Common Market for Eastern and Southern Africa (Comesa) says its efforts to increase trade among member states are finally paying off.
- Areo Zambia, a privately owned airline, says it has spent over $10 million in two years to establish itself as a leading regional airline.
- Two under-five year old boys are killed in what appeared to be ritualistic murders.
- Government calls on China to increase its investment in Zambia.
- Workers at the newly-privatised Lusaka Engineering Company appealed to government to save them from maladministration.
